invalid topology benchmark evidence: unfaulted boundary

observation: Both invalid arms were the child-Workflow member of a protected fanout-128 poison-work pair; both direct-Activity mates passed. The poison child histories ended on Activity attempt 3, and the final attempt began more than 32 seconds after scheduling under a 30-second StartToClose limit. No fault boundary was committed. The other 127 healthy items produced agent process logs and all 128 item stores existed.
inference: The first poison Activity attempt exhausted its StartToClose budget while waiting for the exact 128-item cohort barrier. The prior implementation returned immediately from that barrier on every retry, so attempt 2 could produce the registered poison failure and attempt 3 could quarantine the item without ever committing the required fault. This inference combines the sealed observations with the frozen harness control flow; it is not asserted as a Temporal guarantee.
falsifier: A raw history showing the first poison attempt completed the fault commitment, or a retry-path test showing an uncommitted boundary cannot be bypassed in the v1 source, would falsify the inference.
correction: Require a poison retry to reach any still-uncommitted cohort fault boundary. Preserve v1 as rejected, validate the correction with an exact retry regression and repeated real fanout-128 child-Workflow trials, and execute a new append-only pilot root.
